domains.mathematical: Every natural N,K with K<N; codec separately accepts every natural word length including zero.
domains.literal_R_codec: Integer 1<=N<=31,0<=K<N,valid integer configuration codes,binary words and correctly sized finite numeric tables without NA/NaN. Evaluators require supplied valid scopes.
domains.fixed_fixture_enumeration: The optional supplement uses sixteen explicit cases at N<=12, not enumeration of the full literal R domain.
domains.boundaries: The source sampler N=2,K=1 exception and N=32 encoding/overflow boundary are not Lean topology restrictions.

inheritance_statement: Both deterministic source landscapes instantiate canonical NK. The shared cyclic family is a strict fixed-label restriction of the locus-specific cyclic family; its specified continuous landscape law differs from the independent-table law at the same cyclic topology.
source_precedence: Prose, displayed equations, active R code and added mathematical idealizations remain separate evidence. Literal chapter equation and code agree on sharing; no code-versus-equation error or final-publication discrepancy is established.
probability_scope: Real Lebesgue measure restricted to [0,1], finite entry/locus products and measurable fitness pushforwards at fixed topology. These are explicit idealized joint laws, not R PRNG certificates.

entries.meaning: A proposed canonical deterministic NK representation: binary configurations, component-indexed contribution tables, K other permitted inputs, and arithmetic mean fitness.
entries.hypotheses: Topology N K records K<N, ordered injective K+1 scopes and focal slot zero. Tables may ignore permitted inputs. Fitness uses a field of characteristic zero.
entries.claim_limit: The representation follows the exposition; it does not attribute ownership of NK to its expositor, require essential dependence on each input, or build bounds/independence into deterministic data.

entries.meaning: Fixed-width MSB-first integer/word interpretation. The positional sum also explains h.bin2int, which active get.fitness does not call.

entries.claim_limit: Exact codec laws in Lean; no theorem about R machine operations.
entries.paper_limit: Paper specifies the mathematical landscape; codec/array details and execution limits are code-derived. Mathematical consequences are separately proved, not attributed as source-stated theorems.

entries.meaning: Continuous unit-uniform entry law and finite local-word product.
entries.hypotheses: U has no parameters and uses the standard real Lebesgue/Borel structures; tableUniform accepts any natural K with the finite LocalWord K coordinate index.
entries.claim_limit: Uniform marginals do not on their own establish the full joint law. The chosen product is an explicit idealized specification, not a certificate for runif.

entries.meaning: Nested product over locus tags and local-word entries at a supplied fixed topology.
entries.hypotheses: independentTablesUniform accepts any natural N,K; evaluated independentUniform takes a valid Topology N K. Nested products specify full joint independence.
entries.claim_limit: No verification of R PRNG independence and no distribution over sampled topologies.

entries.meaning: One independently sampled table, shared across all cyclic loci, then realized by canonical fitness.
entries.hypotheses: K<N for the cyclic realization and shared pushforward; any real shared table is evaluated. The probability law on that table is tableUniform K.
entries.claim_limit: Repeated uses of one table entry are shared random values; independence across loci is not asserted.

entries.meaning: Independent-table law specialized to the same fixed cyclic topology as the shared law.
entries.hypotheses: K<N; the independent law uses cyclicTopology hKN, identical to the shared construction at those parameters.
entries.claim_limit: Keeps topology and labels fixed; it is not the as-written chapter sampling construction.

entries.meaning: Finite sums of measurable coordinate projections make both real-valued realization maps measurable in every landscape coordinate.
entries.hypotheses: Valid T:Topology N K for independent realization; K<N for shared realization. Standard Pi measurable structures; no sampled-value bounds assumed.
entries.claim_limit: Product measurable spaces on tables/landscapes, no evaluator injectivity assumption.

entries.meaning: Base, product, and pushforward laws have mass one.
entries.hypotheses: Base/table products at all natural index sizes; mapped law at a supplied Topology or K<N cyclic specialization. Measurability is proved before map normalization.
entries.claim_limit: Pushforward probability uses previously proved realization measurability.

entries.meaning: Restricted Lebesgue half masses and finite product rectangle give exactly (1/4)^N.
entries.hypotheses: Any natural N,K; selected words wx,wy:Fin N→LocalWord K with ∀i,wx i≠wy i. No K<N/topology hypothesis is needed for the data rectangle calculation.
entries.claim_limit: Requires distinct selected words within each locus; remaining entries are unrestricted. No Bernoulli approximation.

entries.meaning: The measurable observable event is reached by a sufficient positive-mass table rectangle.
entries.hypotheses: Event measurable for any x,y:Config N. Pushforward lower bound requires T:Topology N K and ∀i,extract T x i≠extract T y i; T derives N>0.
entries.claim_limit: Strict and weak average comparisons use a valid topology and its derived N>0; lower bound is not exact event mass.

entries.meaning: At N=2,K=0, shared event mass is zero and independent mass is at least 1/16, hence unequal evaluated-landscape measures.
entries.hypotheses: Exactly N=2,K=0, fixed states01 and10 and fixed cyclic topology, using the specified continuous shared and independent laws.
entries.claim_limit: Same cyclic topology and fixed labeled states01/10. Does not assert table-law difference alone or arbitrary recoding obstruction.

entries.meaning: For every K<12, alternating states yield shared mass zero and independent mass at least (1/2)^24, and unequal evaluated laws.
entries.hypotheses: Exactly N=12 and every natural K<12, fixed alternating01/10 labels and the same cyclic topology on both sides. No empirical sampling or dynamics assumption.
entries.claim_limit: Only the twelve-bit rotation/opposition helpers use finite decide; arity proof and continuous mass theorem are generic. No substantive-outcome effect estimate.

entries.meaning: The mathematical constructor requires distinct nonfocal supplied neighbors; source code sorts its sampled neighbors.
entries.hypotheses: The Lean constructor takes K<N plus embeddings and proofs of nonfocality. These validate supplied data, not the R sampler.
entries.claim_limit: At N=2,K=1,i=1, R numeric-singleton sample semantics can select the focal index. Paper N=12 avoids this case. No sampler-correctness theorem is asserted.
